messages.content:
Risk: Toxic content
Description: The AI system may generate or respond with hateful content, such as racist, sexist, or otherwise offensive material.
Concern: None
Policy: Hate Speech

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0048.002: Societal Harm - ATLAS — Societal harms might generate harmful outcomes that reach either the general public or specific vulnerable groups such as the exposure of children to vulgar content. [found by 5/15 queries]
  Siblings: User Harm - ATLAS, Reputational Harm - ATLAS, Financial Harm - ATLAS
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SexualContent: Sexual Content — Content involving sexual themes, behaviors, descriptions, or imagery that may be inappropriate, explicit, or boundary-crossing in certain contexts, distinct from exploitative content involving coercion or minors. [found by 4/15 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PornographicContentDescription: Pornographic Content Description — Descriptions or generation of explicit sexual material intended for sexual arousal, mimicking pornographic media formats. [found by 4/15 queries]
  Siblings: Clinical Sexual Description, Explicit Sexual Description, Reproductive Health Boundary
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SexualFetishContent: Sexual Fetish Content — Content focused on atypical sexual interests or practices that may be considered niche, taboo, or inappropriate in mainstream contexts. [found by 4/15 queries]
  Siblings: Clinical Sexual Description, Explicit Sexual Description, Reproductive Health Boundary
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ThreatsOfViolence: Threats of Violence — Communication of intent to inflict harm or damage to create fear, even if not carried out. [found by 3/15 queries]
  Siblings: Homicide, Glorification of Violence, Weapons Use

axes.rationale: Toxic content can include sexually explicit or inappropriate material, making this class relevant to the risk.
Toxic content often manifests as hate speech or discriminatory language, aligning with this class.
